R8:A CAREFULLY CALIBRATED REBUKE.example: The remark was a carefully calibrated rebuke.

senses.meaning: 表面上願意和解的姿態

examples.en: The offer was a superficially conciliatory gesture.
examples.zh: 提議是表面上願意和解的姿態。

R8:COURTESY DOES NOT NECESSARILY LEAVE R.word: courtesy does not necessarily leave room for dissent
R8:COURTESY DOES NOT NECESSARILY LEAVE R.meaning: 禮貌不一定留下異議空間
R8:COURTESY DOES NOT NECESSARILY LEAVE R.example: Courtesy does not necessarily leave room for dissent.
R8:COURTESY DOES NOT NECESSARILY LEAVE R.exampleZh: 禮貌不一定留下異議空間。

examples.zh: 賭城大道上那座金碧輝煌的假威尼斯運河，是一座憑空捏造、徹底取代了歷史義大利水城的空洞擬像（Simulacrum）。

examples.zh: 這座造價百億的主題樂園精心編織了一座完美無瑕的擬像（Simulacrum），令遊客沉溺其中無法自拔。

R8:SUBLIMITY.meaning: 震撼靈魂之美學崇高境
R8:SUBLIMITY.example: The thundering arctic glacier calving into the ocean stunned onlookers with its terrifying ___.
R8:SUBLIMITY.exampleZh: 極地萬年冰川轟然崩塌砸入怒海的毀滅性巨響，以攝人心魄的美學崇高（Sublimity）震撼了在場所有目擊者。

senses.meaning: 美學中因浩瀚宏偉或毀滅性力量超越感官極限而喚醒崇高震撼與敬畏的精神境界

examples.en: The sheer cosmic sublimity of the starry sky inspired Kant's profound philosophical awe.
examples.zh: 夜空中浩瀚無垠、深不可測的繁星蒼穹，在康德心靈深處激發起了穿越物質世界的美學崇高感（Sublimity）。

examples.en: Postmodern skepticism dismantled the grand metanarrative of uninterrupted human moral progress.
examples.zh: 後現代主義深刻的懷疑鋒芒，將啟蒙運動以來構築的那套人類道德必然不斷進步的宏大敘事（Metanarrative）徹底瓦解。

R8:DISENCHANTMENT.exampleZh: 世俗經驗主義科學的野蠻生長，為人類現代文明不可逆地拉開了宇宙全面世俗祛魅（Disenchantment）的沉重大幕。

MY FAVORITE COLOR IS BLUE.exampleZh: 原句：What is your favorite color?（你最喜歡的顏色是什麼？）最適合的回應是 My favorite color is blue. (我最喜歡藍色

I GET UP AT SEVEN OCLOCK.word: i get up at seven o'clock.

IN A CAF.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Kevin! I am at the café across from the train station. The coffee here is great and they have free Wi-Fi. What time will you arrive?
Q: Where is the writer right now?
IN A CAF.exampleZh: 文中第二句「I am at the café across from the train station.」直接指出作者目前在咖啡廳

A CLIENT IS VISITING.meaning: 因此大家需要穿著正式服裝接見客戶
A CLIENT IS VISITING.example:
【短文理解】[Email to Team] Dear all, our client from Japan will visit our office at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow. Please wear formal clothes and prepare the new product pictures.
Q: Why should the workers dress formally tomorrow?
A CLIENT IS VISITING.exampleZh: 信中提到「our client from Japan will visit our office at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow」，因此大家需要穿著正式服裝接見客戶

AT A HOSPITAL.example:
【短文理解】[Travel Card Note] You can use this travel card for the MRT, city buses, and local trains. You can add money to your card at any convenience store or MRT station.
Q: Where CANNOT you add money to this card according to the note?
AT A HOSPITAL.exampleZh: 文中僅列出便利商店與捷運站可以加值，沒有提到醫院 (hospital)，因此醫院是無法加值的地方

THE WRITER IS SICK.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Amy, I cannot go to the gym with you tonight. I have a bad headache, so I want to go to bed early. Let's exercise together next week.
Q: Why does the writer cancel the gym plan?
THE WRITER IS SICK.exampleZh: 作者提到「I have a bad headache」（頭很痛），說明生病不舒服是取消運動的原因

GO TO THE GARDEN.example:
【短文理解】[Sign at the Library] Quiet, please! Do not talk loudly on your mobile phone in the reading area. If you need to make a call, please walk outside to the garden.
Q: What should people do if they need to speak on the phone?
GO TO THE GARDEN.exampleZh: 告示最後一句指出「If you need to make a call, please walk outside to the garden.」，因此應前往花園

DONT DRINK.example: My parents don't drink coffee in the evening because it keeps them awake all night.
DONT DRINK.exampleZh: 主詞 My parents 為複數名詞，現在簡單式動詞否定句應使用 don't + 原形動詞 drink

ON THE FOURTH FLOOR.meaning: 請使用四樓休息室的機器
ON THE FOURTH FLOOR.example:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] The second-floor coffee machine is broken today. The repair person will fix it tomorrow morning. In the meantime, please use the machine in the break room on the fourth floor.
Q: Where can employees get coffee today?
ON THE FOURTH FLOOR.exampleZh: 告示說明二樓咖啡機故障，臨時方案是「please use the machine in the break room on the fourth floor」（請使用四樓休息室的機器）

EVERY 30 MINUTES.example:
【短文理解】[Bus Timetable Note] Bus Route 5: Bus arrives every 15 minutes on weekdays. On weekends and national holidays, the bus runs once every 30 minutes from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
Q: How often does Route 5 run on Sunday afternoon?
EVERY 30 MINUTES.exampleZh: 週日屬於週末（weekends），文中明確指出「On weekends... the bus runs once every 30 minutes」，因此為每 30 分鐘一班

TO OSAKA.meaning: 明天我們要搭新幹線去大阪
TO OSAKA.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Kyoto] Dear Helen, Greetings from Japan! The weather here is cool and sunny. We visited two old temples yesterday and took hundreds of photos. Tomorrow we are taking a bullet train to Osaka. Best, Mark.
Q: Where will Mark go tomorrow?
TO OSAKA.exampleZh: 明信片中寫道「Tomorrow we are taking a bullet train to Osaka.」（明天我們要搭新幹線去大阪），故選 A

TELL THE FRONT DESK TONIGHT.example:
【短文理解】[Hotel Reception Sign] Breakfast is served from 6:30 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. in the dining room on the 1st floor. If you need early check-out before 6:00 a.m., please inform the front desk tonight.
Q: What should guests do if they want to check out at 5:30 tomorrow morning?
TELL THE FRONT DESK TONIGHT.exampleZh: 文中說明如果需要在早上六點前退房（early check-out before 6:00 a.m.），請「inform the front desk tonight」（今晚告知櫃檯），故選 B

THE STAIRS.example:
【短文理解】[Company Memo] To all staff: The building elevator will be inspected this Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. During this time, the elevator will stop working. Please use the stairs if you come to the office.
Q: What should people use to go upstairs on Saturday morning?
THE STAIRS.exampleZh: 文中提到電梯停用期間「Please use the stairs if you come to the office.」（請走樓梯），故選 C

HER SALES NUMBERS.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Tina, our boss said we have to hand in the sales report by 11:30 a.m. today. I am almost done with my part. Can you send me your sales numbers in ten minutes?
Q: What does the writer need from Tina?
HER SALES NUMBERS.exampleZh: 文中問句明確寫出「Can you send me your sales numbers in ten minutes?」，需要的是業務數字，故選 D

IT ENDS AT 1200 NOON.meaning: 優惠有效至中午十二點止
IT ENDS AT 1200 NOON.example:
【短文理解】[Café Board] Today's Special: Buy any large hot drink and get a chocolate donut for only $10. Offer valid until 12:00 noon. Cash and Line Pay only.
Q: Which is true about the special offer?
IT ENDS AT 1200 NOON.exampleZh: 文中提到「Offer valid until 12:00 noon.」（優惠有效至中午十二點止），因此 A 正確

IN THE BLUE BIN.example:
【短文理解】[Notice at Fitness Center] Clean towels are available at the front counter. Please put used towels into the blue bin next to the shower room after you finish exercising. Thank you for keeping our gym clean.
Q: Where should members put their towels after exercising?
IN THE BLUE BIN.exampleZh: 文中指出「put used towels into the blue bin next to the shower room」，毛巾用完應放入藍色收集桶

SHE EATS AT THE NIGHT MARKET.word: she eats at the night market.
SHE EATS AT THE NIGHT MARKET.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Kenting] Hi Jack, Kenting is amazing! We are staying at a small hotel near the beach. Every morning we go swimming, and in the evening we eat seafood at the night market. See you next Monday! Emily.
Q: What does Emily do in Kenting in the evening?
SHE EATS AT THE NIGHT MARKET.exampleZh: 文中提到「in the evening we eat seafood at the night market」，傍晚在夜市吃海鮮，故選 D

A GUEST BADGE.example:
【短文理解】[Office Sign] Welcome to the New Media Department. All visitors must register at the reception desk on the 1st floor and get a guest badge before going up to the 5th floor.
Q: What must a visitor get on the 1st floor before going upstairs?
A GUEST BADGE.exampleZh: 告示最後指明訪客必須「get a guest badge before going up」（取得訪客證證件），故選 D

PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.word: put the green card on the bed.
PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.meaning: 想換床單需將綠色卡片放在床上
PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.example:
【短文理解】[Notice in Hotel Room] Dear Guest: Our hotel cares about nature. If you want us to change your bedsheets and towels, please put this green card on your bed before 10:00 a.m. Otherwise, we will not change them today.
Q: What should a guest do if they want fresh bedsheets?
PUT THE GREEN CARD ON THE BED.exampleZh: 說明提到「please put this green card on your bed before 10:00 a.m.」，想換床單需將綠色卡片放在床上，故選 B

DONT.example: My brothers are very athletic, but they don't like watching football on TV.
DONT.exampleZh: 主詞 they 是複數代名詞，現在簡單式一般動詞 like 的否定句須搭配助動詞 don't

IN ROOM 204.example:
【短文理解】[School Notice] English Speaking Club meets every Tuesday at 4:30 p.m. in Room 204. Please bring your student ID and a notebook. Everyone is welcome to join!
Q: Where does the English Speaking Club meet?
IN ROOM 204.exampleZh: 公告清楚註記「in Room 204」，故聚會地點選 A

IN THE AFTERNOON.example:
【短文理解】[Weather Board] Taipei Weather Today: Morning: Sunny, 26°C. Afternoon: Sudden heavy rain and thunderstorms, 22°C. Evening: Windy and cool, 19°C.
Q: When are thunderstorms expected today?
IN THE AFTERNOON.exampleZh: 資訊板顯示「Afternoon: Sudden heavy rain and thunderstorms」，午後有雷雨，故選 D

COFFEE CUPS.meaning: 學習製作自己的咖啡杯
COFFEE CUPS.example:
【短文理解】[Community Center Poster] Weekend Pottery Class: Learn to make your own coffee cups! Every Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. All clay and tools are included in the fee.
Q: What do students make in this Saturday class?
COFFEE CUPS.exampleZh: 海報載明「Learn to make your own coffee cups!」（學習製作自己的咖啡杯），故選 A

SHE PICKED STRAWBERRIES.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Hsinchu] Dear Tina, we visited a strawberry farm in Guanxi this morning! We picked a big basket of fresh fruit and tasted sweet jam. Tomorrow we are visiting the old street. Love, Emily.
Q: What did Emily do on the farm this morning?
SHE PICKED STRAWBERRIES.exampleZh: 明信片開頭說明拜訪草莓農場，並提到「picked a big basket of fresh fruit」（採了一大籃新鮮水果），故選 B

THREE LOAVES.example:
【短文理解】[Bakery Sign] Today's Bake: Warm garlic bread comes out of the oven at 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. Limit of three loaves per customer. Cash and EasyCard accepted.
Q: How many loaves of garlic bread can one customer buy at most?
THREE LOAVES.exampleZh: 告示指明「Limit of three loaves per customer」（每位顧客限購三條），故選 C

WASH THEM IMMEDIATELY.example:
【短文理解】[Office Kitchen Notice] Please wash all spoons, mugs, and plates immediately after eating. Do not leave dirty items in the sink overnight. The cleaning team clears the sink every day at 6:00 p.m.
Q: What should employees do with their dirty mugs after using them?
WASH THEM IMMEDIATELY.exampleZh: 告示第 1 句指示「Please wash all spoons, mugs, and plates immediately after eating」，必須立刻清洗，故選 D

A TUNA SANDWICH.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] Mike: 'Hi Sarah, are you coming to lunch with us?' Sarah: 'I have to finish checking this invoice for the boss. Can you bring a tuna sandwich back for me?' Mike: 'Sure, no problem.'
Q: What does Sarah want Mike to bring for her?
A TUNA SANDWICH.exampleZh: Sarah 詢問「Can you bring a tuna sandwich back for me?」，需要的是鮪魚三明治，故選 A

A SWIMMING CAP.example:
【短文理解】[School Swimming Pool Rules] Swimming Pool Hours: Monday-Friday 06:00-21:00. Saturday 08:00-18:00. All swimmers must wear a swimming cap and shower before entering the pool.
Q: What must everyone wear in the pool?
A SWIMMING CAP.exampleZh: 泳池規定「All swimmers must wear a swimming cap」（所有泳客必須戴泳帽），故選 B

PUMPKIN SOUP AND GARLIC BREAD.meaning: 贈送南瓜濃湯與大蒜麵包
PUMPKIN SOUP AND GARLIC BREAD.example:
【短文理解】[Restaurant Daily Special] Thursday Dinner Special: Order any main steak and get a bowl of pumpkin soup and garlic bread for free! Service charge of 10% is included.
Q: What food is free with a main steak on Thursday?
PUMPKIN SOUP AND GARLIC BREAD.exampleZh: 優惠說明「get a bowl of pumpkin soup and garlic bread for free」，贈送南瓜濃湯與大蒜麵包，選 D

BEFORE 330 PM.example:
【短文理解】[School Notice] Dear Students, the school library will close early at 4:00 p.m. this Friday for book cleaning. Please return all borrowed books to the front desk before 3:30 p.m.
Q: What time must students return their books this Friday?
BEFORE 330 PM.exampleZh: 告示明確指出「Please return all borrowed books to the front desk before 3:30 p.m.」，因此還書截止時間是 3:30 p.m. 前

THE COMPANY MEETING FINISHES LATE.meaning: 公司會議今晚會很晚結束
THE COMPANY MEETING FINISHES LATE.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi Mom, the company meeting will finish late tonight. I cannot join the family dinner at 6:30. Please don't wait for me and eat first.
Q: Why will the sender miss the family dinner?
THE COMPANY MEETING FINISHES LATE.exampleZh: 簡訊開頭解釋「the company meeting will finish late tonight」（公司會議今晚會很晚結束），故選 C

BRUSHES AND PAPER.meaning: 畫筆與畫紙全部免費提供
BRUSHES AND PAPER.example:
【短文理解】[Holiday Activity Poster] Weekend Art Workshop: Learn to paint flowers this Saturday from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Fee: $300 per person. All brushes and paper are provided for free.
Q: What is provided for free at the workshop?
BRUSHES AND PAPER.exampleZh: 海報末句載明「All brushes and paper are provided for free.」（畫筆與畫紙全部免費提供），故選 A

TO THE HOT SPRINGS.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Yilan] Dear Grandma, we are having a wonderful holiday in Yilan! Yesterday we visited a tea farm, and today we went to the hot springs. The air here is very fresh. Love, Penny.
Q: Where did Penny go today?
TO THE HOT SPRINGS.exampleZh: 明信片提到「today we went to the hot springs」（今天去了溫泉），故選 B

LOCK THE FRONT DOOR.meaning: 最後離開者必須鎖大門
LOCK THE FRONT DOOR.example:
【短文理解】[Office Notice] Please remember to lock the front door if you are the last person to leave the office in the evening. Also, make sure all lights are switched off.
Q: What should the last worker do before leaving?
LOCK THE FRONT DOOR.exampleZh: 告示指出「remember to lock the front door if you are the last person to leave」，最後離開者必須鎖大門，故選 C

A CARTON OF FRESH MILK.example:
【短文理解】[Bakery Discount Note] Buy two loaves of toast after 7:00 p.m. and get a carton of fresh milk for half price! This special discount is available every evening while supplies last.
Q: What item is half price after 7:00 p.m. when buying two loaves of toast?
A CARTON OF FRESH MILK.exampleZh: 告示說明「get a carton of fresh milk for half price」（鮮奶半價），故選 D

FOUR PLAYERS.meaning: 現在有四個人，還差一位
FOUR PLAYERS.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message] Hi David, do you want to play badminton at the sports center this Saturday morning? We have four people now and we need one more player. Let me know today!
Q: How many players do they have right now?
FOUR PLAYERS.exampleZh: 簡訊提到「We have four people now and we need one more player.」（現在有四個人，還差一位），因此目前有 4 人，選 A

PUT THEM INTO THEIR BAGS.meaning: 上課時需將手機放進包包
PUT THEM INTO THEIR BAGS.example:
【短文理解】[School Classroom Rules] 1. Arrive in class before 8:10 a.m. 2. Put mobile phones into your bags during lessons. 3. Raise your hand before you ask a question.
Q: What should students do with their mobile phones during lessons?
PUT THEM INTO THEIR BAGS.exampleZh: 規則第 2 條指明「Put mobile phones into your bags during lessons」，上課時需將手機放進包包，故選 B

STAY INSIDE THEIR HOMES.example:
【短文理解】[Weather Warning Note] Weather Warning: A strong typhoon is coming tomorrow. All schools and office buildings in the city will be closed. Please stay inside your home safely.
Q: What should people in the city do tomorrow?
STAY INSIDE THEIR HOMES.exampleZh: 警報文末提醒「Please stay inside your home safely.」（請安全待在家中），故選 C

REFUND OR EXCHANGE THEM.example:
【短文理解】[Clothing Store Sign] Season Clearance Sale: All summer shirts and shorts are 30% off! Sale ends this Sunday. No refunds or exchanges for sale items.
Q: What can a customer NOT do with the items bought on sale?
REFUND OR EXCHANGE THEM.exampleZh: 告示最後一句特別說明「No refunds or exchanges for sale items」（特價品不退不換），因此不能退換貨，選 D

FRESH MILK.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Taitung] Dear Andy, Taitung is very quiet and beautiful. We stayed at a small farm yesterday and drank fresh milk. Tomorrow morning we plan to ride bicycles along the forest path. Best regards, Grace.
Q: What did Grace drink at the farm yesterday?
FRESH MILK.exampleZh: 明信片寫道「We stayed at a small farm yesterday and drank fresh milk.」，因此昨天喝的是鮮奶，選 A

ON WEDNESDAY.example:
【短文理解】[Supermarket Member Notice] VIP Member Day is every Wednesday. Members get 10 bonus points for every $100 spent. Points can be used as cash on your next visit.
Q: On which day can members earn bonus points?
ON WEDNESDAY.exampleZh: 通知首句指明「VIP Member Day is every Wednesday.」（會員日為每週三），故選 B

DOESNT.exampleZh: Mr. Lin ___ work here. 主詞是第三人稱單數，一般動詞的否定需用 doesn't

NO IT IS NOT.example:
【短文理解】[Store Sign] Open Monday to Friday. Closed on Saturday and Sunday.
Q: Is the store open on Sunday?
NO IT IS NOT.exampleZh: 告示寫「Closed on Saturday and Sunday.（週六與週日休息）」，因此週日沒有營業，選 B

RAISE A HAND TO SPEAK.example:
【短文理解】[School Rules] 1. Do not eat or drink during the lesson. 2. Please turn off your phone. 3. Raise your hand if you want to speak.
Q: What can a student do?

STILL WATER PLEASE.example: The word is still water, please..
STILL WATER PLEASE.exampleZh: 服務生詢問要「常溫水還是氣泡水？」（Still or sparkling water），最適當的回答是「請給我們常溫水」（Still water, please）

SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.word: sure, i will email it now.
SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.meaning: 沒問題，我現在寄電子郵件給你
SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
SURE I WILL EMAIL IT NOW.exampleZh: 對方提出請求「Could you please send me the file? (能否請你寄檔案給我？)」，適當回答為「Sure, I will email it now. (沒問題，我現在寄電子郵件給你)」

BLACK WITH NO SUGAR PLEASE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
BLACK WITH NO SUGAR PLEASE.exampleZh: 服務生或同事詢問咖啡喜好「How would you like your coffee? (你的咖啡想要怎麼調配？)」，回答「Black with no sugar, please. (請給我黑咖啡，不要糖)」最正確

MR CHEN IS LEADING IT.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
MR CHEN IS LEADING IT.exampleZh: 題目詢問負責人「Who is responsible for this project? (誰負責這個專案？)」，回答人選「Mr. Chen is leading it. (陳先生正在主導它)」最切合句意

WATER WOULD BE GREAT THANK YOU.word: water would be great, thank you.
WATER WOULD BE GREAT THANK YOU.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
WATER WOULD BE GREAT THANK YOU.exampleZh: 對方提供飲品選擇「Would you like some tea or water? (你想要喝茶還是水？)」，回答「Water would be great, thank you. (開水就好，謝謝你)」最自然合適

YES NEXT TO THE HOTEL.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES NEXT TO THE HOTEL.exampleZh: 詢問附近有無銀行「Is there a bank near here? (這附近有銀行嗎？)」，回答地點「Yes, next to the hotel. (有的，在飯店旁邊)」最正確

SURE NO PROBLEM.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
SURE NO PROBLEM.exampleZh: 請求對方重述「Could you repeat that? (你可以再說一次嗎？)」，答覆「Sure, no problem. (當然，沒問題)」最禮貌合適

AT FIVE THIRTY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
AT FIVE THIRTY.exampleZh: 詢問火車發車時間「What time does the train leave? (火車幾點開？)」，回答時間「At five thirty. (五點半)」最正確

ABOUT AN HOUR.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
ABOUT AN HOUR.exampleZh: 詢問時間長度「How long is the meeting? (會議有多長？)」，回答時間長度「About an hour. (大約一小時)」最正確

THE BLACK ONE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
THE BLACK ONE.exampleZh: 詢問哪一個是特定物品「Which one is your bag? (哪一個是你的包包？)」，回答物品特徵「The black one. (黑色的那一個)」最正確

NO EVERYTHING IS CLEAR.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
NO EVERYTHING IS CLEAR.exampleZh: 會議或解說後詢問「Do you have any questions? (你有任何問題嗎？)」，回答「No, everything is clear. (沒有，一切都很清楚)」最合適

I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.word: i need your help with a file.
I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.meaning: 我需要你幫忙處理一個檔案
I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I NEED YOUR HELP WITH A FILE.exampleZh: 對方詢問「Why did you call me? (你為什麼打給我？)」，回答原因「I need your help with a file. (我需要你幫忙處理一個檔案)」最正確

IT WAS GREAT I WENT TO TAIPEI.word: it was great, i went to taipei.
IT WAS GREAT I WENT TO TAIPEI.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT WAS GREAT I WENT TO TAIPEI.exampleZh: 對方詢問「How was your weekend? (你週末過得如何？)」，回答「It was great, I went to Taipei. (很棒，我去了台北)」最合適

IT BELONGS TO MR LIN.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
IT BELONGS TO MR LIN.exampleZh: 對方詢問物品擁有者「Whose bag is this? (這是誰的包包？)」，回答「It belongs to Mr. Lin. (這是林先生的)」最合適

ID LOVE TO THANK YOU.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
ID LOVE TO THANK YOU.exampleZh: 對方提出邀請「Would you like to join us for dinner? (你想和我們一起吃晚餐嗎？)」，欣然接受「I'd love to, thank you. (我很樂意，謝謝)」最禮貌合適

RIGHT THIS WAY PLEASE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
RIGHT THIS WAY PLEASE.exampleZh: 在餐廳門口詢問「Can we have a table for two? (我們能有兩個人的位子嗎？)」，服務生回答「Right this way, please. (請走這邊)」最標準

YES IT IS VERY CHEAP.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES IT IS VERY CHEAP.exampleZh: 詢問購買意願「Do you want to buy it? (你想買它嗎？)」，回答意願與理由「Yes, it is very cheap. (想，它很便宜)」最合理

I LIKE THE RED ONE.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I LIKE THE RED ONE.exampleZh: 詢問顏色偏好「Which color do you like? (你喜歡哪一個顏色？)」，回答「I like the red one. (我喜歡紅色的那一個)」最正確

GO TO THE SERVICE DESK.meaning: 在服務台領取免費飲料兌換券
GO TO THE SERVICE DESK.example:
【短文理解】[Flight Ticket Message] Flight BR28 to San Francisco is delayed. The new departure time is 11:45 p.m. Passengers can wait at Gate 12 and get a free drink voucher from the service desk.
Q: What should passengers do if they want a free drink?
GO TO THE SERVICE DESK.exampleZh: 文末指出旅客可以「get a free drink voucher from the service desk」（在服務台領取免費飲料兌換券），故選 B

THERE IS NO TRASH COLLECTION ON SUNDAY.word: there is no trash collection on sunday.
THERE IS NO TRASH COLLECTION ON SUNDAY.example:
【短文理解】[Apartment Rules] Welcome to your new home. Please do not play loud music after 10:00 p.m. Put your trash bags in the collection area on the first floor before 8:00 a.m. every morning except Sunday.
Q: Which of the following is true according to the rules?
THERE IS NO TRASH COLLECTION ON SUNDAY.exampleZh: 文中「every morning except Sunday」表示星期日沒有垃圾清運，故選 B

MARY.meaning: 瑪麗今天將代替他主持
MARY.example:
【短文理解】[Business Email] Dear Team, John is sick today and cannot lead the marketing meeting at 3 p.m. Mary will take his place today. Please send your weekly reports to Mary before 2 p.m.
Q: Who will lead the marketing meeting today?
MARY.exampleZh: 文中明確提到「Mary will take his place today」（瑪麗今天將代替他主持），因此今天由 Mary 主持會議

A PERSON WHO WANTS TO WORK ON WEEKENDS.word: a person who wants to work on weekends.
A PERSON WHO WANTS TO WORK ON WEEKENDS.example:
【短文理解】[Job Advertisement] Star Coffee Shop is looking for a weekend waiter. Working hours are from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturdays and Sundays. Good English communication skills are welcome. Please call Mr. Wu at 0912-345-678.
Q: Who can apply for this job?
A PERSON WHO WANTS TO WORK ON WEEKENDS.exampleZh: 該職缺為「weekend waiter」，工作時間為「Saturdays and Sundays」，因此適合能在週末工作的人

NO BECAUSE TRAIN 107 DOES NOT STOP THERE.word: no, because train 107 does not stop there.
NO BECAUSE TRAIN 107 DOES NOT STOP THERE.example:
【短文理解】[Express Train Schedule] Train 105: Leaves Taipei at 07:15, arrives in Taichung at 08:20, arrives in Zuoying at 09:10. Train 107: Leaves Taipei at 07:45, does NOT stop in Taichung, arrives in Zuoying at 09:20.
Q: If Mr. Lin takes Train 107 in Taipei, can he get off at Taichung?
NO BECAUSE TRAIN 107 DOES NOT STOP THERE.exampleZh: 時刻表明確說明 Train 107「does NOT stop in Taichung」（不停靠台中），因此林先生無法在台中下車，故選 D

WRITE THE SUMMARY PAGE.meaning: 他接下來會去寫總結頁面
WRITE THE SUMMARY PAGE.example:
【短文理解】[Text Message Chain] John: 'Hey Lisa, the manager wants us to finish the presentation slides before our 3:00 meeting.' Lisa: 'I already finished the charts. Can you write the summary page?' John: 'Sure, I can do that now.'
Q: What will John do next?
WRITE THE SUMMARY PAGE.exampleZh: Lisa 詢問 John 能否寫總結頁面（Can you write the summary page?），John 回答「Sure, I can do that now.」，表示他接下來會去寫總結頁面，故選 A

THEIR TABLE MAY BE GIVEN AWAY.word: their table may be given away.
THEIR TABLE MAY BE GIVEN AWAY.meaning: 桌位將轉讓給現場候位客人
THEIR TABLE MAY BE GIVEN AWAY.example:
【短文理解】[Restaurant Policy Note] Table reservations are held for 10 minutes only. If all guests are not present within 10 minutes after the reserved time, your table will be given to waiting walk-in customers.
Q: What happens if a group of four arrives 15 minutes late for their reservation?
THEIR TABLE MAY BE GIVEN AWAY.exampleZh: 規定說明座位僅保留 10 分鐘，若逾時「table will be given to waiting walk-in customers」（桌位將轉讓給現場候位客人），遲到 15 分鐘桌位可能不保，故選 B

RIDE BICYCLES ALONG THE COAST.example:
【短文理解】[Postcard from Hualien] Dear Eric, Taroko Gorge is breathtaking! Yesterday we walked along the Shakadang Trail. My sister was tired, but she finished the entire walk. Tomorrow we will ride bicycles along the coast before heading home. See you Tuesday! Ken.
Q: What is Ken's plan for tomorrow?
RIDE BICYCLES ALONG THE COAST.exampleZh: 文中「Tomorrow we will ride bicycles along the coast before heading home.」直接點出明天的行程是沿海岸騎腳踏車，故選 C

IT IS NOT OPEN IN THE AFTERNOON.word: it is not open in the afternoon.
IT IS NOT OPEN IN THE AFTERNOON.meaning: 因此週六下午並未開診
IT IS NOT OPEN IN THE AFTERNOON.example:

THE DURATION OF THE JOURNEY.meaning: 題目只以騎乘時間區分收費
THE DURATION OF THE JOURNEY.example: 【短文】A city offers free bike hire for journeys under thirty minutes. Longer journeys incur a fee, even when the bike is returned to the original station. What determines whether a fee applies?
THE DURATION OF THE JOURNEY.exampleZh: 題目只以騎乘時間區分收費，回原站也不能免除超時費

HAS BEEN STUDYING.meaning: 定從去年春天延續到現在仍進行中的學習
HAS BEEN STUDYING.example: She began lessons last spring and still attends them. Which form links that start to an activity continuing now? She has been studying the language for almost a year.
HAS BEEN STUDYING.exampleZh: 指定從去年春天延續到現在仍進行中的學習，用現在完成進行式 has been studying；其餘把觀察點移到過去或未來

STATING THE RELATIONSHIP EXPLICITLY.example: 【語意】The novel leaves the reader to draw the connection. What does it avoid?
STATING THE RELATIONSHIP EXPLICITLY.exampleZh: leave...to draw the connection 是讓讀者自行建立關聯

HAD BEEN WAITING.example: We had been waiting at the station for an hour when the cancellation was finally announced.
HAD BEEN WAITING.exampleZh: for an hour 表等待持續時間，when 引出已發生的過去宣布時點，需以過去完成進行式連接更早開始的等待；其餘以現在或未來為參照

IT IS NOT YET FULLY CONFIRMED.word: it is not yet fully confirmed.
IT IS NOT YET FULLY CONFIRMED.example: 【語意】The reservation is provisional until payment is received. What is its status?
IT IS NOT YET FULLY CONFIRMED.exampleZh: provisional 是暫定，until 設定轉為確定的條件

CANCELLATION MUST OCCUR BEFORE DEPARTURE.example: 【條件】Refunds are available only for tickets cancelled before departure. Which requirement is stated?
CANCELLATION MUST OCCUR BEFORE DEPARTURE.exampleZh: only for 與 before 限定退費條件，不能擴張為所有票皆可退

HAS BEEN RESTORED.example: The gate will remain closed until the damaged seal has been restored by the maintenance team.
HAS BEEN RESTORED.exampleZh: seal 是維修團隊修復的對象，by 指明施事者；has been restored 是完成式被動

A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.word: a journey beyond the valley’s boundary.
A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.meaning: 越界行程不在明示承諾內
A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.example: 【語意】The guardian offers protection, but only within the valley. Which journey falls outside the stated promise?
A JOURNEY BEYOND THE VALLEYS BOUNDARY.exampleZh: only within 限定地域，越界行程不在明示承諾內

THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.word: the condition attached to the welcome.
THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.meaning: 歡迎附帶繳存武器條件
THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.example: 【短文】A village gives travellers shelter on condition that they leave their weapons outside. One traveller insists that being welcomed means he may carry his sword inside. What has he overlooked?
THE CONDITION ATTACHED TO THE WELCOME.exampleZh: 歡迎附帶繳存武器條件，不能只採前半承諾

HAD LIFTED.example: By the time we reached the clearing, the mist had lifted.
HAD LIFTED.exampleZh: reached 設定過去觀察時點，霧在抵達前已散去；過去完成式 had lifted 表此前已完成

SOME SECTIONS OF THE PATH ARE SLIPPERY.word: some sections of the path are slippery.
SOME SECTIONS OF THE PATH ARE SLIPPERY.example: 【語意】The path is slippery in places. What does in places tell walkers?
SOME SECTIONS OF THE PATH ARE SLIPPERY.exampleZh: in places 指某些地段，不是全線同樣情況

HAD CHARGED.meaning: 對已發生的過去表遺憾
HAD CHARGED.example: I wish I had charged the camera before leaving home; the battery is flat.
HAD CHARGED.exampleZh: 對已發生的過去表遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式

WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.meaning: 現在或未來的混合條件句
WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.example: The session ended an hour ago. If I had known it was outdoors, I would have brought a warmer jacket with me yesterday.
WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.exampleZh: 活動與帶外套的時機均已過去，if had known 對應未實現的過去結果 would have brought；不是現在或未來的混合條件句

USE THE PENALTY COUNT TO BREAK THE TIE.word: use the penalty count to break the tie.
USE THE PENALTY COUNT TO BREAK THE TIE.example: 【短文】A competition ranks teams by points. If points are equal, fewer penalties decides the order. Two teams have equal points, but one has fewer penalties. Which rule applies?
USE THE PENALTY COUNT TO BREAK THE TIE.exampleZh: 題幹給同分排序規則；不是改寫得分

HAD BEEN RECORDED.example: The presenter said that the interview had been recorded the previous evening.
HAD BEEN RECORDED.exampleZh: said 與 the previous evening 建立過去轉述及更早完成的錄製；訪談是被錄製的對象，用 had been recorded

A CONCISE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT HAPPENED.word: a concise description of what happened.
A CONCISE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT HAPPENED.example: 【語意】The editor asks for a brief account of the meeting. What is requested?
A CONCISE DESCRIPTION OF WHAT HAPPENED.exampleZh: brief account 是簡短敘述，不是逐字稿或未來預測

AN INTERRUPTION IS POSSIBLE ON FRIDAY.word: an interruption is possible on friday.
AN INTERRUPTION IS POSSIBLE ON FRIDAY.example: 【範圍】A notice says the service may be interrupted on Friday. Which paraphrase preserves its certainty?
AN INTERRUPTION IS POSSIBLE ON FRIDAY.exampleZh: may 是可能，未說必然、整天或每週

ITS LOUDNESS RATHER THAN ITS PRESENCE.word: its loudness rather than its presence.
ITS LOUDNESS RATHER THAN ITS PRESENCE.example: 【語用】I do not mind the music, just not at a volume that fills every room. What is being challenged?
ITS LOUDNESS RATHER THAN ITS PRESENCE.exampleZh: 不反對音樂本身，只反對音量影響全部房間；未限定器材

WILL BE ABLE.meaning: 詢問即將到來的星期六實際能否出席
WILL BE ABLE.example: Today is Monday. Please let us know by this Thursday whether you will be able to attend this coming Saturday. We need your actual availability, not a hypothetical past situation.
WILL BE ABLE.exampleZh: 詢問即將到來的星期六實際能否出席，will be able to 表未來能力或可行性；其他形式描述過去或反事實情況

A CHOICE BETWEEN TWO PERIODS OF DUTY.word: a choice between two periods of duty.
A CHOICE BETWEEN TWO PERIODS OF DUTY.example: 【語意】Volunteers may choose a morning or afternoon shift, but not both. What is offered?
A CHOICE BETWEEN TWO PERIODS OF DUTY.exampleZh: or ... but not both 明示二擇一，不保證工作量相同

A COPY MADE TO RESEMBLE THE ORIGINAL KEY.word: a copy made to resemble the original key.
A COPY MADE TO RESEMBLE THE ORIGINAL KEY.example: 【語意】The display contains a replica of the original key. What is on display?
A COPY MADE TO RESEMBLE THE ORIGINAL KEY.exampleZh: replica 是仿製複本，不是原件保證

THE AGE IMPLIED BY THE DESCRIPTION.word: the age implied by the description.
THE AGE IMPLIED BY THE DESCRIPTION.example: 【語意】The object is older than the label suggests. What is being questioned?
THE AGE IMPLIED BY THE DESCRIPTION.exampleZh: label suggests 指標籤傳達物件年代，不是標籤紙本年齡

ACROSS THE ROOM FROM HER.example: 【空間】Mara stood beside the door while Ben waited on the opposite side of the room. Where was Ben in relation to Mara?
ACROSS THE ROOM FROM HER.exampleZh: opposite side of room 指隔著房間對面，不是都在門邊

WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.word: where he had just put the letter.
WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.meaning: 行動先後顯示忘了自己放入口袋
WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.example: 【短文】Owen put the letter in his pocket, then searched the desk for it. His sister watched without speaking until he checked the pocket. What had he apparently forgotten?
WHERE HE HAD JUST PUT THE LETTER.exampleZh: 行動先後顯示忘了自己放入口袋，未交代作者或來意

HAD VISITED.example: She spoke as though she had visited the place before, although she later admitted it was her first visit.
HAD VISITED.exampleZh: 她假裝先前曾來訪，實際卻是第一次；as though 後用過去完成式呈現比過去說話時更早、且與事實不符的經驗

IT QUIETLY UNDERCUTS HIS CLAIM.meaning: 遞回他未留在身邊的鑰匙形成不必明說的反證
IT QUIETLY UNDERCUTS HIS CLAIM.example: 【短文】At dinner, Leo announced that he never misplaced anything. His mother slid his keys across the table without comment. What effect does her action have?
IT QUIETLY UNDERCUTS HIS CLAIM.exampleZh: 遞回他未留在身邊的鑰匙形成不必明說的反證

TEN CENTIMETRES.example: 【尺寸】The card must be at least ten centimetres wide. Which width meets that requirement?
TEN CENTIMETRES.exampleZh: at least 包含等於下限，未說一定大於十

THE CARD IS FOLDED.example: 【順序】Fold the card before adding the ribbon. What should happen first?
THE CARD IS FOLDED.exampleZh: before 明確指定折卡在加緞帶前

TO BE CHANGED.example: The design allows the cover to be changed without removing the pages.
TO BE CHANGED.exampleZh: allow + 受詞 + to be changed，封面被換

THE PARK.example: 【路線】The library is between the station and the park. Starting at the station, you reach the library before the park. What comes next along that route?
THE PARK.exampleZh: 沿指定路線依序 station/library/park，圖內資訊已完整

ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.word: access is restricted for a stated period.
ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.meaning: 告示只限制樓上至中午
ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.example: 【範圍】A sign says the upper floor is closed until noon. What does it establish?
ACCESS IS RESTRICTED FOR A STATED PERIOD.exampleZh: 告示只限制樓上至中午，不擴及全部建物

THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.word: the route chosen affects the distance.
THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.meaning: 短路程依賴行人橋路線
THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.example: 【語用】It is only a short walk, provided you use the footbridge rather than follow the road all the way round. What qualifies the claim?
THE ROUTE CHOSEN AFFECTS THE DISTANCE.exampleZh: 短路程依賴行人橋路線，未保證普遍可及性

HAD PUT.example: I wish the audience had put their phones on silent before the show began.
HAD PUT.exampleZh: 對過去未做的事遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式

TO ALLOW THE REMAINING WORDS TO BE HEARD.word: to allow the remaining words to be heard.
TO ALLOW THE REMAINING WORDS TO BE HEARD.example: 【短文】The audience laughs before a character finishes a sentence. The actor waits, then delivers the last few words when the room is quiet. What is the likely reason?
TO ALLOW THE REMAINING WORDS TO BE HEARD.exampleZh: 等笑聲退以免蓋台詞，未給忘詞證據

A FOLDER.example: 【指涉】I can lend you the blue folder, but I need the red one back tonight. What does one refer to?
A FOLDER.exampleZh: one 代替前面的 folder，red one 為紅文件夾

TUESDAY AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON.word: tuesday at four in the afternoon.
TUESDAY AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON.example: 【短文】A message reads, I am free on Tuesday after three, or on Thursday before noon. Which proposed meeting fits?
TUESDAY AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON.exampleZh: after three / before noon 分別限定不同日，不能跨用時段

HAD NOT ENDED UP.meaning: 過去未回覆的反事實條件
HAD NOT ENDED UP.example: I would have replied sooner if your message had not ended up in the wrong folder.
HAD NOT ENDED UP.exampleZh: 過去未回覆的反事實條件，用 had not ended up

HAD DISAPPEARED.example: By the time we reached the ridge, the sun had disappeared behind the clouds.
HAD DISAPPEARED.exampleZh: 過去抵達前已不見，用過去完成式

THE RIVER.example: 【空間】The path ran along the river, with the hill to our left and the water to our right. What was immediately to the walkers’ right?
THE RIVER.exampleZh: water 與river同指，明示位於右側

WATER FALLING FROM WET LEAVES.meaning: 雨停後葉上餘水仍滴落
WATER FALLING FROM WET LEAVES.example: 【順序】The rain stopped before dawn, but the leaves were still dripping when the first light appeared. What persisted after the rain?
WATER FALLING FROM WET LEAVES.exampleZh: 雨停後葉上餘水仍滴落，與雨繼續不同

ONE BOX AND TWO INDIVIDUAL CUPS.word: one box and two individual cups.
ONE BOX AND TWO INDIVIDUAL CUPS.example: 【數量】A box contains six cups. A customer needs eight cups and may buy individual cups as well as boxes. Which purchase supplies exactly eight?
ONE BOX AND TWO INDIVIDUAL CUPS.exampleZh: 六加二等八；題內提供單購選項

THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.word: the item must carry the relevant mark.
THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.meaning: 題內未設價格高低門檻
THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.example: 【範圍】A sign says the offer applies to marked items only. Which condition matters?
THE ITEM MUST CARRY THE RELEVANT MARK.exampleZh: only限markeditems，題內未設價格高低門檻

THE EXPLICIT CLOSING-TIME CONDITION.example: 【短文】A stall lends tools for a day and asks borrowers to return them before closing. A visitor assumes a day means the following morning. What should govern the return?
THE EXPLICIT CLOSING-TIME CONDITION.exampleZh: 題內明訂截止，不以抽象一天代替

SHE MAY TAKE ONE MORE ITEM.word: she may take one more item.
SHE MAY TAKE ONE MORE ITEM.example: 【短文】An exchange table lets visitors take one item for each item they leave. Jo leaves three objects, takes two, and asks whether she has used the whole allowance. What follows from the rule?
SHE MAY TAKE ONE MORE ITEM.exampleZh: 三換三上限，已取二還可一，未說必須取滿

THE PARCEL ARRIVED BEFORE THREE.example: 【短文】A message says, The parcel arrived after lunch but before Eva left. Eva left at three. What is established?
THE PARCEL ARRIVED BEFORE THREE.exampleZh: afterlunch/beforeleft限定抵達三點前，未定精時

MAY CHOOSE TO MAKE OR OMIT.word: may choose to make or omit
MAY CHOOSE TO MAKE OR OMIT.example: A move described as optional is one a player may choose to make or omit.
MAY CHOOSE TO MAKE OR OMIT.exampleZh: optional可選，不指定勝負或必先做

REVEALING THE CARD.example: 【順序】Draw a card, reveal it, and then move your piece. Which action immediately precedes moving?

TWO RED TOKENS AND NO BLUE TOKENS LEFT.word: two red tokens and no blue tokens left.
TWO RED TOKENS AND NO BLUE TOKENS LEFT.example: 【規則】A player may exchange two blue tokens for one red token. Jo has four blue tokens and no red tokens. She makes this exchange twice. What does she have from those exchanges?
TWO RED TOKENS AND NO BLUE TOKENS LEFT.exampleZh: 每次消二藍換一紅，兩次耗四藍得二紅

WAS LIVING.example: The interviewer asked me where I was living when the old theatre closed.
WAS LIVING.exampleZh: 間接問句用陳述語序，過去時背景為was living

WRITE DOWN WHAT WAS SAID.example: To transcribe an interview is to write down what was said.
WRITE DOWN WHAT WAS SAID.exampleZh: transcribe將口語轉成書面，不必作真假判決

THE UNCLE.example: 【指涉】I showed the photograph to my uncle, and he recognised the woman beside the gate. Who recognised the woman?

AN ASSUMPTION BUILT INTO THE QUESTION.word: an assumption built into the question.
AN ASSUMPTION BUILT INTO THE QUESTION.example: 【短文】An interviewer asks how difficult the move was. The speaker says she had found it exciting rather than difficult. What did the speaker correct?
AN ASSUMPTION BUILT INTO THE QUESTION.exampleZh: how difficult預設困難，回答拒絕此框架

THE BELL.example: 【指涉】The bell rang after the choir finished, and its sound filled the hall. What does its refer to?
THE BELL.exampleZh: 主句the bell rang後的its sound承接鈴聲；並未提指揮

HAD WE OPENED.example: Hardly had we opened the door when the alarm began to ring.
HAD WE OPENED.exampleZh: Hardly置句首需倒裝；先開門後響鈴，用had we opened

TO ALLOW FOR A POSSIBLE DELAY.word: to allow for a possible delay.
TO ALLOW FOR A POSSIBLE DELAY.example: 【語意】We have kept the afternoon free in case the morning session runs over. What is the purpose?
TO ALLOW FOR A POSSIBLE DELAY.exampleZh: in case為預先防備可能狀況；不保證會延誤或一定提早結束

THE SLEEVES ARE TOO LONG.example: 【語意】The jacket fits across the shoulders, but the sleeves need shortening. What is the problem?
THE SLEEVES ARE TOO LONG.exampleZh: need shortening表示袖長過長，肩部尺寸合適已明說

HAD TRIED.meaning: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾
HAD TRIED.example: I wish I had tried the coat on before buying it; it is much heavier than I expected.
HAD TRIED.exampleZh: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾，用wish加過去完成式had tried

WORN WITH EITHER SIDE FACING OUT.word: worn with either side facing out
WORN WITH EITHER SIDE FACING OUT.example: A reversible jacket can be worn with either side facing out.
WORN WITH EITHER SIDE FACING OUT.exampleZh: reversible指正反兩面皆可穿，不涉及退貨權或洗法

THE SHORTER ROUTE IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.word: the shorter route is no longer available.
THE SHORTER ROUTE IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.example: 【路線】The riverside path is shorter, but it closes at dusk. It is already dark, so we will take the road through the village. Why was that route chosen?
THE SHORTER ROUTE IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE.exampleZh: 路徑黃昏關閉，現在已黑；選村內道路是可用性，不是距離改變

RECOGNISING WHERE THEY ARE.example: 【字彙】The guide suggests using the clock tower as a landmark when walking back. What should visitors use it for?
RECOGNISING WHERE THEY ARE.exampleZh: landmark在找路語境是可辨識位置的地標，未要求讀時間或進入塔內

HAD CHECKED.example: By the time we reached the junction, the guide had checked the route twice already.
HAD CHECKED.exampleZh: reached為過去參照點，already與twice表示此前已完成兩次，用過去完成式

THE FOOTBRIDGE.meaning: 否接近自行增加通行條件
THE FOOTBRIDGE.example: 【指涉】The footbridge runs beside the railway bridge, but only the former is open to walkers. Which bridge may walkers use?
THE FOOTBRIDGE.exampleZh: former指前述第一者footbridge，不能由火車是否接近自行增加通行條件

WHAT THE LINE STYLES MEAN.meaning: 題內說明線型對應坡度
WHAT THE LINE STYLES MEAN.example: 【短文】A map uses a dotted line for a steep path and a solid line for a flatter one. The key explains this distinction. What should a visitor check before choosing?
WHAT THE LINE STYLES MEAN.exampleZh: 題內說明線型對應坡度，應讀圖例；沒有提供更新時間或終點差別

HAS BEEN DISCUSSING.example: The committee has been discussing the proposed tax reforms for three hours without reaching a consensus.
HAS BEEN DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 句中有「for three hours」強調動作持續進行且尚未結束，符合現在完成進行式的使用時機

IS EXPECTED TO BE REVIEWED.example: The controversial policy is expected to be reviewed by the board of directors during next month's meeting.
IS EXPECTED TO BE REVIEWED.exampleZh: 政策是「被預期將被審查」，需使用「is expected to be + V-p.p.」的複雜被動語態

HAVE BEEN INVESTIGATING.example: Scientists have been investigating this rare phenomenon since 2015, yet its true origin remains a mystery.
HAVE BEEN INVESTIGATING.exampleZh: 「since 2015」加上現在式「remains」，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式

IT HAS BEEN LOSING MONEY RECENTLY.word: it has been losing money recently.
IT HAS BEEN LOSING MONEY RECENTLY.example: 【短文】Memo: The upcoming quarterly report is currently being drafted by the finance team. It is expected to be finalized by Friday. Since we have been experiencing a substantial deficit, all department heads must have prepared their cost-cutting strategies prior to the meeting. Q: What is implied about the company's financial status?
IT HAS BEEN LOSING MONEY RECENTLY.exampleZh: 短文中提到「experiencing a substantial deficit」（經歷大幅虧損），因此暗示公司最近在賠錢

HAVE BEEN INVESTING.example: Our competitors have been investing aggressively in artificial intelligence for the past few years to gain market share.
HAVE BEEN INVESTING.exampleZh: for the past few years 表示動作的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式

TO BE ANNOUNCED.example: The new regulations are rumored to be announced next week, although official confirmation is still pending.
TO BE ANNOUNCED.exampleZh: be rumored to be + V-p.p. 表示「據傳將被...」，法規是被公布的對象

HAD BEEN ADVOCATING.example: The environmental group had been advocating for stricter carbon emission laws long before the recent climate summit.
HAD BEEN ADVOCATING.exampleZh: 在「過去的」氣候高峰會之前，就一直持續在倡議，屬於過去完成進行式的使用情境（比過去更早並持續）

INTRODUCING FLEXIBLE WORKING SCHEDULES.example: 【短文】Case Study: TechNova Inc. has been struggling with employee retention for two years. Industry analysts speculate that the rigid corporate culture must have driven top talent away. To combat this, flexible working hours are expected to be implemented next quarter. Q: What is the proposed solution to TechNova's problem?
INTRODUCING FLEXIBLE WORKING SCHEDULES.exampleZh: 文章最後提到「flexible working hours are expected to be implemented」（預計實施彈性工時）以解決問題

A GROUP OF MEDICAL EXPERTS.meaning: 公認由醫學專家聯盟起草
A GROUP OF MEDICAL EXPERTS.example: 【短文】Policy Brief: The new healthcare reform aims to alleviate the burden on public hospitals. It is widely acknowledged to have been drafted by a coalition of medical experts. However, critics argue that the policy is fundamentally flawed. Q: Who is believed to be the author of the reform?
A GROUP OF MEDICAL EXPERTS.exampleZh: 文中指出「It is widely acknowledged to have been drafted by a coalition of medical experts」（公認由醫學專家聯盟起草）

TO HAVE BEEN STOLEN.example: The confidential documents are reported to have been stolen from the executive's office last night.
TO HAVE BEEN STOLEN.exampleZh: 報導現在發生（are reported），但失竊發生在昨晚，需用 to have been stolen 表達過去完成的被動概念

HAS BEEN RISING.example: Inflation has been rising steadily over the past six months, causing widespread concern among consumers.
HAS BEEN RISING.exampleZh: over the past six months 表達這半年來不斷進行的趨勢，選現在完成進行式

CRITICAL AND CONDEMNATORY.example: 【短文】Editorial: The mayor's decision to cut public transit funding is fundamentally flawed. Citizens have been complaining about service delays for months. This disastrous policy is guaranteed to be met with fierce protests. The administration must have severely underestimated the public's reliance on buses and trains. Q: What is the author's attitude toward the mayor's decision?
CRITICAL AND CONDEMNATORY.exampleZh: 作者使用了 fundamentally flawed (根本上有缺陷), disastrous policy (災難性政策) 等詞彙，顯示其態度為強烈批評(Critical)

HAS BEEN EXAMINING.example: The legal team has been examining the contract details meticulously since the dispute arose.
HAS BEEN EXAMINING.exampleZh: 「since」引導的時間起點搭配「has been examining」，強調動作一直持續

TO HAVE BEEN.example: The new marketing strategy is considered to have been extremely successful in boosting sales.
