TO BE REPLACED.example: The outdated inventory management software is scheduled to be replaced by a cloud-based AI system this weekend.
TO BE REPLACED.exampleZh: is scheduled to be + V-en，軟體「被取代」，故用被動不定詞 to be replaced

TO HAVE BEEN ORCHESTRATED.example: The misappropriation of humanitarian funds is alleged to have been orchestrated by several high-ranking officials who recently resigned.
TO HAVE BEEN ORCHESTRATED.exampleZh: is alleged to have been V-en 是複雜被動語態，意為「據稱過去已被...策劃」

IT TORE EASILY DURING TRANSIT.meaning: 缺乏耐用度，運送中常破裂
IT TORE EASILY DURING TRANSIT.example:
【短文】Innovation Review: Our design team has been experimenting with bio-degradable packaging materials. The traditional plastic wrap is proven to have contributed massively to landfill overflow. Earlier iterations of the eco-packaging must have lacked durability, as customers frequently complained about tears during shipping.
Q: Why did customers complain about the earlier eco-packaging?
IT TORE EASILY DURING TRANSIT.exampleZh: 文中提到 must have lacked durability, as customers frequently complained about tears during shipping（缺乏耐用度，運送中常破裂），對應選項 C

HAS BEEN DRAFTING.meaning: 動作從過去持續到現在
HAS BEEN DRAFTING.example: The lead architect has been drafting a novel blueprint that emphasizes both functionality and aesthetic appeal for months.
HAS BEEN DRAFTING.exampleZh: 句尾有 for months，表示動作從過去持續到現在，因此選現在完成進行式 has been drafting

TO BE EMBRACED.example: The controversial aesthetic choices in the new app update are considered to be embraced by younger users.
TO BE EMBRACED.exampleZh: are considered to be V-en 表示「被認為被（某人）...」

YES WE SHOULD PROBABLY SUBMIT MORE PROOF.word: yes, we should probably submit more proof.
YES WE SHOULD PROBABLY SUBMIT MORE PROOF.meaning: 對，我們可能應該提交更多證明
YES WE SHOULD PROBABLY SUBMIT MORE PROOF.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES WE SHOULD PROBABLY SUBMIT MORE PROOF.exampleZh: 原句：他們一定是因為證據不足而拒絕了申請

I AGREE TRAFFIC WAS BACKED UP FOR MILES.word: i agree. traffic was backed up for miles.
I AGREE TRAFFIC WAS BACKED UP FOR MILES.meaning: 我同意。車流回堵了好幾英里
I AGREE TRAFFIC WAS BACKED UP FOR MILES.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I AGREE TRAFFIC WAS BACKED UP FOR MILES.exampleZh: 原句：通勤者今天早上一定對突如其來的道路封閉感到沮喪

I HOPE THEY APPROVE THE PERMITS QUICKLY.word: i hope they approve the permits quickly.
I HOPE THEY APPROVE THE PERMITS QUICKLY.meaning: 我希望他們能趕快批准許可
I HOPE THEY APPROVE THE PERMITS QUICKLY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I HOPE THEY APPROVE THE PERMITS QUICKLY.exampleZh: 原句：建築圖紙正在由城市的區劃委員會評估

WILL HAVE WELCOMED.example: The museum opened ten years ago. By the time it closes for renovation next June, it will have welcomed visitors for eleven years.
WILL HAVE WELCOMED.exampleZh: By...next June 設定未來完成的時間點，用 will have＋過去分詞；museum 是接待者，不是被接待者

RECORDING POINTS DURING THE GAME.example: 【語用】Would you mind keeping the score while I play? What is requested?
RECORDING POINTS DURING THE GAME.exampleZh: keep the score 是記分，不是保存球具

RESERVING THE SHELF FOR SHARED ITEMS.word: reserving the shelf for shared items.
RESERVING THE SHELF FOR SHARED ITEMS.example: 【語用】Could we keep this shelf for things we both use? What is proposed?
RESERVING THE SHELF FOR SHARED ITEMS.exampleZh: keep ... for things we both use 指保留作共同用途

OFFERING LIMITED HELP WITH PREPARATION.meaning: 同意布置並限定離開時間
OFFERING LIMITED HELP WITH PREPARATION.example: 【語用】I can help set up, though I will need to leave before the guests arrive. What is the speaker doing?
OFFERING LIMITED HELP WITH PREPARATION.exampleZh: 同意布置並限定離開時間，非全盤拒絕

TAKING PICTURES WITHOUT USING THE FLASH.word: taking pictures without using the flash.
TAKING PICTURES WITHOUT USING THE FLASH.example: 【語用】You are welcome to take photographs, but please leave the flash off. What is permitted?
TAKING PICTURES WITHOUT USING THE FLASH.exampleZh: 明示允許拍照，限制在閃光燈，不加其他條件

PEOPLE HAVE EATEN THE CAKE.example: 【語用】A guest looks at the empty plate and says, I take it the cake was popular. What is inferred?
PEOPLE HAVE EATEN THE CAKE.exampleZh: 由空盤推蛋糕受歡迎的幽默推論；不是確證所有人喜歡

MILD REPROACH FOR NOT BEING WARNED.word: mild reproach for not being warned.
MILD REPROACH FOR NOT BEING WARNED.example: 【語氣】You might have mentioned the stairs, said the visitor, looking at the suitcase she had carried up four floors. What is conveyed?
MILD REPROACH FOR NOT BEING WARNED.exampleZh: might have mentioned 在此責怪未提前提醒，以情境確定語氣

SHE ACCEPTED THE HELP WITH SOME CAUTION.word: she accepted the help with some caution.
SHE ACCEPTED THE HELP WITH SOME CAUTION.meaning: 感謝配合不放手顯示有保留接受
SHE ACCEPTED THE HELP WITH SOME CAUTION.example: 【短文】A stranger offered to carry Jo’s bag. She thanked him but kept her hand on the strap until they reached the crowded platform. What is the strongest supported reading?
SHE ACCEPTED THE HELP WITH SOME CAUTION.exampleZh: 感謝配合不放手顯示有保留接受，不能據此確定有犯罪

A GAP SEPARATING ADJACENT LABELS.example: 【語用】Could you leave a little space between the labels so I can cut them apart? What is requested?
A GAP SEPARATING ADJACENT LABELS.exampleZh: between labels 為裁開留間隔，非空白標籤或字體大小

RED BLUE GREEN.example: 【空間】Place the blue card between the red card and the green card, all in one row. Which order fits?
RED BLUE GREEN.exampleZh: blue 須在 red/green 中間，正答為其中一個方向

THE RIBBONS WIDTH RATHER THAN ITS COLOUR.word: the ribbon’s width rather than its colour.
THE RIBBONS WIDTH RATHER THAN ITS COLOUR.example: 【短文】An example uses a green ribbon. The note says any colour may be used as long as the ribbon is narrow enough to pass through the hole. What matters for this step?
THE RIBBONS WIDTH RATHER THAN ITS COLOUR.exampleZh: any colour 排除色限制，narrow enough 指寬度適配

AN INDICATION OF WHICH WAY TO GO.word: an indication of which way to go.
AN INDICATION OF WHICH WAY TO GO.example: 【語用】Could you point me towards the information desk? What help is requested?
AN INDICATION OF WHICH WAY TO GO.exampleZh: point towards 是指引方向，不必親自帶路

IT COULD BE HEARD AT THE BACK.word: it could be heard at the back.
IT COULD BE HEARD AT THE BACK.example: 【語意】Her voice carried to the back of the room. What does carried mean here?
IT COULD BE HEARD AT THE BACK.exampleZh: voice carried 指聲音傳得到，不是實體搬運

THE VILLAGE BECAME EASIER TO SEE.word: the village became easier to see.
THE VILLAGE BECAME EASIER TO SEE.example: 【語意】The village came into sight as the mist thinned. What changed?
THE VILLAGE BECAME EASIER TO SEE.exampleZh: 能見度改善，非村落移動或改建

THEIR VISIBLE EXTENT SEEMED VERY LARGE.word: their visible extent seemed very large.
THEIR VISIBLE EXTENT SEEMED VERY LARGE.example: 【語意】The fields stretched as far as we could see. What is conveyed?
THEIR VISIBLE EXTENT SEEMED VERY LARGE.exampleZh: as far as could see 限於視野印象，不證世界無界

LIGHT AMUSEMENT AT AN ORDINARY MISTAKE.word: light amusement at an ordinary mistake.
LIGHT AMUSEMENT AT AN ORDINARY MISTAKE.example: 【語用】That is one mystery solved, says Lee after finding his glasses on his head. What is the tone?
LIGHT AMUSEMENT AT AN ORDINARY MISTAKE.exampleZh: 普通忘物自嘲用mystery，非外部刑案背景

ANSWERING WITHOUT FEELING RUSHED.example: 【語用】Take your time; we are not trying to fit the whole story into one minute. What is encouraged?
ANSWERING WITHOUT FEELING RUSHED.exampleZh: take your time允許從容，不是限更短

A CHANGE IS POSSIBLE BUT NOT PREFERRED.word: a change is possible but not preferred.
A CHANGE IS POSSIBLE BUT NOT PREFERRED.example: 【語用】I could move my appointment, but I would rather not unless it is necessary. What is the speaker saying?
A CHANGE IS POSSIBLE BUT NOT PREFERRED.exampleZh: could表示可行，would rather not表示不偏好，unless保留必要時例外

THE BADGES RATHER THAN THE COAT ALONE.word: the badges rather than the coat alone.
THE BADGES RATHER THAN THE COAT ALONE.example: 【短文】A theatre uses the same grey coat for two characters. Each wears a different badge, allowing the audience to distinguish them. What identifies the characters?
THE BADGES RATHER THAN THE COAT ALONE.exampleZh: 同件灰外套不獨立區分角色，不同徽章才是指定線索

THE LOCATION OF THE MUSEUM ENTRANCE.word: the location of the museum entrance.
THE LOCATION OF THE MUSEUM ENTRANCE.example: 【路線】The museum entrance has moved to the courtyard. The map still shows it on the main street. Which information needs updating?
THE LOCATION OF THE MUSEUM ENTRANCE.exampleZh: 搬動的是入口；未說街名、庭院位置或開放時間改變

THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN MATHEMATICS.word: they were highly skilled in mathematics.
THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN MATHEMATICS.meaning: 建造者一定具備先進的數學知識
THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN MATHEMATICS.example: 【綜合】Science Journal: Anthropologists have been debating the purpose of the newly discovered ruins. The complex structure is hypothesized to have been utilized as a celestial observatory. Given the precision of the stonework, the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge. Q: What is the main conclusion drawn about the ancient builders?
THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN MATHEMATICS.exampleZh: 短文推論「the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge」（建造者一定具備先進的數學知識），故選 B

THE COMPANYS STOCK VALUE DROPPED SHARPLY.word: the company's stock value dropped sharply.
THE COMPANYS STOCK VALUE DROPPED SHARPLY.meaning: 漏洞發生後公司股票暴跌
THE COMPANYS STOCK VALUE DROPPED SHARPLY.example: 【綜合】Tech News: Developers have been working around the clock to patch a critical vulnerability. The security flaw is reported to have compromised the data of millions of users. The company's stock plummeted following the breach; investors must have panicked over the potential legal liabilities. Q: What was the consequence of the security flaw?
THE COMPANYS STOCK VALUE DROPPED SHARPLY.exampleZh: 文章明確指出「The company's stock plummeted following the breach」（漏洞發生後公司股票暴跌）

IT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN THOROUGH ENOUGH.word: it might not have been thorough enough.
IT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN THOROUGH ENOUGH.meaning: 暗示初步審計可能不夠徹底
IT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN THOROUGH ENOUGH.example: 【綜合】Corporate Memo: The merger with Apex Corp is anticipated to be finalized by the fourth quarter. Both legal teams have been scrutinizing the contractual obligations diligently. Any discrepancies found now must have been overlooked during the initial audit phase. Q: What is implied about the initial audit phase?
IT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN THOROUGH ENOUGH.exampleZh: 文中提到「現在發現的任何差異一定是在初步審計階段被忽略的」，暗示初步審計可能不夠徹底

A WORK STOPPAGE BY EMPLOYEES.example: 【綜合】Travel Advisory: Travelers have been experiencing unprecedented delays at the international terminal due to a staff strike. The situation is estimated to be resolved within 48 hours. Passengers whose flights were cancelled must have been notified via email or text message. Q: What caused the delays at the international terminal?
A WORK STOPPAGE BY EMPLOYEES.exampleZh: 短文指出延誤是由於「staff strike」（員工罷工），即選項中的 work stoppage by employees

HAD THE CEO BEGUN.meaning: 主要子句應用過去完成式
HAD THE CEO BEGUN.example: Scarcely had the CEO begun the press conference when a reporter asked a provocative question about the scandal.
HAD THE CEO BEGUN.exampleZh: 否定副詞 Scarcely 放句首時需倒裝，且配合 when 引導的過去式子句，主要子句應用過去完成式，故選 had the CEO begun

IT LIKELY USED A NEW STRUCTURAL APPROACH.word: it likely used a new structural approach.
IT LIKELY USED A NEW STRUCTURAL APPROACH.meaning: 一定使用了一種全新的晶體結構
IT LIKELY USED A NEW STRUCTURAL APPROACH.example: 【短文】Abstract Snippet: Scientists have been attempting to synthesize a room-temperature superconductor for decades. The recent breakthrough is widely considered to be a pivotal moment in electrical engineering. The lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure, as traditional models consistently failed. Q: How does the recent breakthrough differ from past attempts?
IT LIKELY USED A NEW STRUCTURAL APPROACH.exampleZh: 文中提到 lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure (一定使用了一種全新的晶體結構)，故選 C

THE INDUSTRIAL REVOLUTION IN EUROPE.meaning: 據說靈感來自歐洲工業革命
THE INDUSTRIAL REVOLUTION IN EUROPE.example: 【短文】Book Review: The author has been weaving intricate political allegories into her fantasy worlds for years. Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution. Readers familiar with her style must have quickly identified the parallels between the fictional empire and 19th-century Britain. Q: What is the primary inspiration for the author's latest book?
THE INDUSTRIAL REVOLUTION IN EUROPE.exampleZh: 文中直接說明 Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution (據說靈感來自歐洲工業革命)

HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING TO HAVE CREATED.word: have been fluctuating / to have created
HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING TO HAVE CREATED.example: The commodity prices have been fluctuating / to have created wildly this month. Speculators are thought ___ artificial shortages to drive up the value.
HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING TO HAVE CREATED.exampleZh: 前半句強調這個月以來持續的波動，用 have been fluctuating；後半句表示投機客被認為「已經製造了」人為短缺，用 to have created

HAVE BEEN TRACKING TO HAVE CAUSED.word: have been tracking / to have caused
HAVE BEEN TRACKING TO HAVE CAUSED.example: Local authorities have been tracking / to have caused the factory's wastewater discharge for weeks. The toxic chemicals are confirmed ___ heavy damage to the nearby wetlands.
HAVE BEEN TRACKING TO HAVE CAUSED.exampleZh: 第一格表示持續數週的追蹤 (have been tracking)

HAVE BEEN COMPLAINING TO HAVE CAUSED.word: have been complaining / to have caused
HAVE BEEN COMPLAINING TO HAVE CAUSED.meaning: 過去被懷疑造成了火災
HAVE BEEN COMPLAINING TO HAVE CAUSED.example: Customers have been complaining / to have caused of faulty wiring in the blenders since May. The severe overheating is suspected ___ several kitchen fires last week.
HAVE BEEN COMPLAINING TO HAVE CAUSED.exampleZh: 第一格用現在完成進行式表示自五月以來持續的抱怨；第二格用 to have caused 表示「過去被懷疑造成了火災」

HAVE BEEN OBSERVING TO HAVE OCCURRED.word: have been observing / to have occurred
HAVE BEEN OBSERVING TO HAVE OCCURRED.meaning: 認知突破據報導發生得比預期早
HAVE BEEN OBSERVING TO HAVE OCCURRED.example: Researchers have been observing / to have occurred the monkeys' reactions to mirror reflections. The cognitive breakthrough is reported ___ earlier than initially predicted.
HAVE BEEN OBSERVING TO HAVE OCCURRED.exampleZh: 研究員一直持續觀察 (have been observing)；認知突破據報導發生得比預期早，用 to have occurred (occur 不用被動)

HAVE BEEN DRAWING TO HAVE BEEN.word: have been drawing / to have been
HAVE BEEN DRAWING TO HAVE BEEN.example: The CEO's questionable tax records have been drawing / to have been intense public scrutiny. The missing documents are assumed ___ deliberately destroyed before the audit.
HAVE BEEN DRAWING TO HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 一直在引來公眾審視用 have been drawing；文件被假設「已經被銷毀」，用完成式被動不定詞 to have been destroyed

YES HIS AGILITY HERE IS TRULY UNMATCHED.word: yes, his agility here is truly unmatched.
YES HIS AGILITY HERE IS TRULY UNMATCHED.meaning: 是的，他在這裡的敏捷度真的無人能及
YES HIS AGILITY HERE IS TRULY UNMATCHED.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
YES HIS AGILITY HERE IS TRULY UNMATCHED.exampleZh: 原句：The reigning champion is perceived to be unbeatable on this specific terrain. (這位衛冕冠軍在這種特定的地形上被認為是不可戰勝的

HAS BEEN CLIMBING.meaning: 留任率從那時起持續在攀升中
HAS BEEN CLIMBING.example: The retention rate has been climbing gradually since the executives introduced a hybrid work model.
HAS BEEN CLIMBING.exampleZh: 句中有 since 帶出的過去時間點，主句需用現在完成進行式，表示留任率從那時起持續在攀升中

HAS BEEN HIKING.example: The local government has been hiking the subway fares continuously, causing widespread public outrage among daily commuters.
HAS BEEN HIKING.exampleZh: continuously 強調動作一直延續至今，政府不斷調漲票價，因此使用現在完成進行式 has been hiking

THEY PAID OFF OFFICIALS.example:
【短文】Investigative Report: The local dairy farm has been operating without a valid license. Their raw milk products are alleged to have caused a regional outbreak of listeria. The facility managers must have bribed the inspectors to ignore the gross health code violations.
Q: What did the factory managers allegedly do?
THEY PAID OFF OFFICIALS.exampleZh: 文中指出經理「bribed the inspectors (賄賂檢查員)」，與 paid off officials 意思一致

TO HAVE BEEN PROMPTED.example: The sudden closure of the popular bakery chain is rumored to have been prompted by a severe pest infestation in their central kitchen.
TO HAVE BEEN PROMPTED.exampleZh: 關店謠傳是「被」嚴重的蟲害所引起的

THEY SECRETLY RECORD USERS.example:
【短文】Article: Security experts have been monitoring the new smart home devices. The built-in microphones are proven to have recorded private conversations without consent. The manufacturer must have intentionally hidden this tracking feature deep within the terms of service.
Q: What is the main concern regarding the smart devices?
THEY SECRETLY RECORD USERS.exampleZh: 文章指出麥克風在未經同意下錄下私人對話 (recorded private conversations without consent)，即暗中錄音

TO HAVE CAST.example: The deployment of unregulated surveillance drones is feared to have cast a chilling effect on public gatherings and free speech.
TO HAVE CAST.exampleZh: 無人機的部署被恐懼「已經產生了 (cast)」寒蟬效應，因是主動發出的動作且強調已造成影響，故選 to have cast

HAS THE NEW PRODUCT BOOSTED.example: Not only has the new product boosted our market share, but we have also been outperforming industry benchmarks consistently.
HAS THE NEW PRODUCT BOOSTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：Not only 置於句首時，其後的子句需倒裝 (助動詞移至主詞前)

MEMORIES ARE STRENGTHENED AND ORGANIZED.example:
【短文】Neuro-Science: Neuroscientists have been mapping the brain's neural pathways during deep sleep. Memory consolidation is proven to be facilitated by these slow-wave patterns. Individuals who sleep poorly must have experienced a significant disruption in this critical restorative phase.
Q: What happens during slow-wave sleep?
MEMORIES ARE STRENGTHENED AND ORGANIZED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文章提到 Memory consolidation (記憶鞏固/強化) 是由慢波模式 (slow-wave patterns) 促進的

HAD THE CITY LAUNCHED.example: Scarcely had the city launched the new recycling initiative when they realized they lacked the facilities to process the collected materials.
HAD THE CITY LAUNCHED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Scarcely (幾乎不/一...就...) 置於句首時，主要子句需倒裝，通常搭配過去完成式 (had + S + p.p.)，後面跟 when 加上過去式子句

THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN METALWORKING.word: they were highly skilled in metalworking
THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN METALWORKING.example:
【短文】Gallery Review: The historical society has been showcasing a collection of rare medieval artifacts. A magnificent jewel-encrusted sword is purported to have belonged to a legendary king. The craftsmen who forged it must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills.
Q: What is said about the sword's creators?
THEY WERE HIGHLY SKILLED IN METALWORKING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文中稱讚鍛造這把劍的工匠 (craftsmen)「must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills (一定擁有無與倫比的冶金/金屬加工技巧)」

TO ATTRACT POTENTIAL MATING PARTNERS.example:
【短文】Science Weekly: Researchers have been observing the peculiar mating rituals of the bird of paradise. The vibrant plumage is considered to have evolved specifically to attract mates in dense jungles. The ancestors of these birds must have faced intense sexual selection pressures.
Q: Why did the vibrant plumage evolve?
TO ATTRACT POTENTIAL MATING PARTNERS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文章明確指出鮮豔的羽毛 (vibrant plumage) 被認為是為了「attract mates (吸引配偶)」而演化出來的

FOR CONDUCTING A SUPERFICIAL EVALUATION.meaning: 意即檢驗員只做了草率的檢查
FOR CONDUCTING A SUPERFICIAL EVALUATION.example:
【綜合】Lease Dispute Summary: The commercial tenant has been demanding compensation for the water damage. The faulty plumbing is proven to have caused severe structural decay prior to the move-in date. The property inspector must have conducted a superficial evaluation during the initial handover.
Q: Why is the property inspector criticized?
FOR CONDUCTING A SUPERFICIAL EVALUATION.exampleZh: 短文中提到「must have conducted a superficial evaluation」，意即檢驗員只做了草率的檢查

A LEGAL CHALLENGE IN COURT.meaning: 預期將在法庭上受到挑戰
A LEGAL CHALLENGE IN COURT.example:
【短文】Energy Critique: The utility provider has been raising tariffs without prior consultation. The sudden spike in electricity bills is projected to be challenged in court by consumer advocacy groups. The executives must have assumed the public would simply absorb the extra cost without resistance.
Q: What action will likely be taken against the tariff increase?
A LEGAL CHALLENGE IN COURT.exampleZh: 文中指出「The sudden spike in electricity bills is projected to be challenged in court (預期將在法庭上受到挑戰)」，即訴諸法律行動

SOCIETYS FOCUS ON UNIVERSITY DEGREES.example:
【短文】Reform Editorial: We have been witnessing a steady decline in vocational training enrollment. The societal obsession with university degrees is largely blamed for this trend. The Ministry of Education must have neglected to promote the lucrative career paths available in skilled trades.
Q: Why is vocational enrollment declining according to the editorial?
SOCIETYS FOCUS ON UNIVERSITY DEGREES.exampleZh: 文章表示「The societal obsession with university degrees is largely blamed for this trend (社會對大學學歷的迷戀很大程度上是這個趨勢的原因)」

BECAUSE A SITUATION WAS HANDLED POORLY.word: because a situation was handled poorly
BECAUSE A SITUATION WAS HANDLED POORLY.meaning: 所以人員正在接受衝突解決訓練
BECAUSE A SITUATION WAS HANDLED POORLY.example:
【短文】Quality Assurance Report: The front desk staff has been undergoing intensive conflict resolution training. A recent altercation in the lobby is confirmed to have been handled unprofessionally. The duty supervisor must have lacked the necessary experience to de-escalate the situation effectively.
Q: Why is the staff undergoing training?
BECAUSE A SITUATION WAS HANDLED POORLY.exampleZh: 因為近期大廳的爭執 (altercation) 被證實處理得不專業 (handled unprofessionally)，所以人員正在接受衝突解決訓練

TO TAP INTO A PROFITABLE MARKET NICHE.word: to tap into a profitable market niche
TO TAP INTO A PROFITABLE MARKET NICHE.example:
【短文】Hospitality Trends: Boutique hotels have been capitalizing on the demand for eco-friendly tourism. Their use of sustainable toiletries is widely praised by environmentally conscious travelers. Larger chains must have noticed this lucrative niche, as they are rapidly adopting similar practices.
Q: Why are larger chains adopting sustainable practices?
TO TAP INTO A PROFITABLE MARKET NICHE.exampleZh: lucrative niche 意指「利潤豐厚的利基市場」，大型連鎖飯店必定是注意到了這個商機才會跟進採用永續做法

THE CODE WAS INDEPENDENTLY DEVELOPED.meaning: 專有程式碼被驗證為獨立開發
THE CODE WAS INDEPENDENTLY DEVELOPED.example:
【短文】Arbitration Update: The mediation board has been striving to resolve the software copyright conflict peacefully. The proprietary code is verified to have been independently developed, not stolen. The accusing party must have jumped to conclusions based solely on the superficial similarities in the final product.
Q: What did the mediation board verify?
THE CODE WAS INDEPENDENTLY DEVELOPED.exampleZh: 短文第二句「The proprietary code is verified to have been independently developed (專有程式碼被驗證為獨立開發)」為解答依據

TO PROVIDE AN EXCUSE FOR TEARING IT DOWN.word: to provide an excuse for tearing it down
TO PROVIDE AN EXCUSE FOR TEARING IT DOWN.meaning: 故意扣留維修資金以合理化其最終的拆毀
TO PROVIDE AN EXCUSE FOR TEARING IT DOWN.example:
【短文】Heritage Newsletter: Activists have been campaigning to save the century-old library from demolition. The architectural integrity of the building is recognized to have been compromised by years of neglect. The city administration must have intentionally withheld maintenance funds to justify its eventual destruction.
Q: Why was the building neglected according to activists?
TO PROVIDE AN EXCUSE FOR TEARING IT DOWN.exampleZh: 文中寫道市政府必定是「intentionally withheld maintenance funds to justify its eventual destruction (故意扣留維修資金以合理化其最終的拆毀)」，選 A

HAVE BEEN ARGUING.meaning: 動作從過去持續到現在
HAVE BEEN ARGUING.example:
A: Are the regional managers still debating the budget cuts?
B: Yes, they have been arguing over the disproportionate funding allocated to the marketing team for hours.
HAVE BEEN ARGUING.exampleZh: for hours 表示動作從過去持續到現在，且雙方仍在爭論，應使用現在完成進行式 have been arguing

HAVE BEEN EXPLORING.example:
A: Has the tourism committee finalized the new preservation guidelines?
B: Not yet. They have been exploring ways to alleviate the pressure on the historic sites without deterring visitors.
HAVE BEEN EXPLORING.exampleZh: Not yet 表示動作尚未完成且仍在進行，使用現在完成進行式 have been exploring 表示「一直都在探索」

THE RELIANCE ON FOSSIL FUELS.meaning: 對化石燃料的依賴被認為阻礙了經濟韌性
THE RELIANCE ON FOSSIL FUELS.example:
【短文】NGO Strategic Review: The foundation has been channeling funds into renewable energy projects in developing nations. The reliance on fossil fuels is considered to have hindered economic resilience in these regions. The previous administration must have overlooked the vital importance of sustainable infrastructure when drafting their development plans. 
Q: According to the review, what hindered economic resilience?
THE RELIANCE ON FOSSIL FUELS.exampleZh: 文中明確寫出 The reliance on fossil fuels is considered to have hindered economic resilience (對化石燃料的依賴被認為阻礙了經濟韌性)

THE ONGOING EMBARGO.meaning: 由於持續的禁運而完全崩潰
THE ONGOING EMBARGO.example:
【短文】NGO Impact Report: Our volunteers have been dispensing essential medicines in the conflict zones for months. The local healthcare system is widely acknowledged to have collapsed completely due to the ongoing embargo. The international mediators must have severely misjudged the devastating humanitarian toll when they imposed the sanctions. 
Q: What caused the local healthcare system to collapse?
THE ONGOING EMBARGO.exampleZh: 文中明確寫出 to have collapsed completely due to the ongoing embargo (由於持續的禁運而完全崩潰)

HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZED.example: The intricate legal documents have been scrutinized by the compliance officers for weeks, yet the jurisdictional boundaries remain largely undefined.
HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文件是「被審查」，加上 for weeks 表示持續一段時間，嚴格的現在完成進行被動態非常罕見且笨重，通常以現在完成被動態 (have been scrutinized) 代替來表達已完成或持續被動的狀態

TO HAVE BEEN INITIATED.example: The massive data breach in the healthcare system is highly suspected to have been initiated by a sophisticated phishing email targeted at senior physicians.
TO HAVE BEEN INITIATED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：is suspected to... 接不定詞，且引起資料外洩是過去發生的被動事件，故用完成被動不定詞 to have been initiated

LOCAL WARLORDS STOLE THEM.meaning: 強烈懷疑是由當地軍閥策劃的
LOCAL WARLORDS STOLE THEM.example: 【綜合】International Aid Journal: The UN has been advocating for a more transparent distribution network. The sudden disappearance of emergency rations is strongly suspected to have been orchestrated by local warlords. The convoy leaders must have deviated from the secured routes without authorization. Q: What is the main suspicion regarding the missing rations?
LOCAL WARLORDS STOLE THEM.exampleZh: 文章提到 disappearance... is strongly suspected to have been orchestrated by local warlords（強烈懷疑是由當地軍閥策劃的），故選 B（stole them 為同義轉換）

PREMATURE MELTING OF THE ICE.example: 【綜合】Climate Bulletin: Scientists have been documenting the erratic migration patterns of Arctic terns. The displacement of their breeding grounds is proven to have been caused by early ice melts. The birds must have struggled to find adequate food sources during their prolonged journeys. Q: What is the primary cause of the birds' displaced breeding grounds?
PREMATURE MELTING OF THE ICE.exampleZh: 文章提到 displacement... is proven to have been caused by early ice melts（早期冰融化），選項 C (Premature melting) 為同義替換

HAS BEEN CIRCUMVENTING.example: The multinational corporation has been circumventing domestic labor laws by classifying full-time staff as freelancers for years.
HAS BEEN CIRCUMVENTING.exampleZh: for years 強調動作持續，The multinational corporation 為單數，故選 has been circumventing（一直規避）

HAS BEEN TRACKING.meaning: 主句需用完成式或完成進行式
HAS BEEN TRACKING.example: Since the rebranding campaign launched, the marketing department has been tracking user engagement metrics across all social platforms.
HAS BEEN TRACKING.exampleZh: Since 帶出過去時間起點，主句需用完成式或完成進行式，單數主詞 the marketing department 搭配 has been tracking

NOTICE AND JUDGE DIFFERENCES IN QUALITY.word: notice and judge differences in quality
NOTICE AND JUDGE DIFFERENCES IN QUALITY.example: A discerning diner is especially able to notice and judge differences in quality.
NOTICE AND JUDGE DIFFERENCES IN QUALITY.exampleZh: discerning 指有敏銳辨別與判斷力，非食量或烹飪能力

A PROVISIONAL JUDGEMENT OPEN TO REVISION.word: a provisional judgement open to revision
A PROVISIONAL JUDGEMENT OPEN TO REVISION.example: A tentative identification should be understood as a provisional judgement open to revision.
A PROVISIONAL JUDGEMENT OPEN TO REVISION.exampleZh: tentative 是暫定而可能修正，不等於捏造

THE SCALE OF WHAT IT AIMS TO ACHIEVE.word: the scale of what it aims to achieve.
THE SCALE OF WHAT IT AIMS TO ACHIEVE.example: 【語意】The programme is ambitious rather than merely busy. What is emphasised?
THE SCALE OF WHAT IT AIMS TO ACHIEVE.exampleZh: ambitious 重點是企圖與目標尺度，非只是項目多

INTRODUCING AN ADMISSION CHARGE.example: 【範圍】The support is offered on the understanding that the event remains free to attend. What would require renewed agreement?
INTRODUCING AN ADMISSION CHARGE.exampleZh: on understanding that 是承諾條件，收費會改變關鍵前提

ITS HISTORY BEFORE IT ENTERED THE MUSEUM.word: its history before it entered the museum.
ITS HISTORY BEFORE IT ENTERED THE MUSEUM.example: 【語意】The provenance is documented only from the object’s arrival at the museum. What remains uncertain?
ITS HISTORY BEFORE IT ENTERED THE MUSEUM.exampleZh: only from 限定紀錄起點，更早沿革未明

IT ACCOMMODATES MINOR INACCURACIES.example: 【語用】The guide calls the process forgiving: a small error need not spoil the result. What is meant?
IT ACCOMMODATES MINOR INACCURACIES.exampleZh: forgiving 指容錯能力，small 限定可容錯範圍

A DEFINED RANGE OF ACCEPTABLE VARIATION.word: a defined range of acceptable variation.
A DEFINED RANGE OF ACCEPTABLE VARIATION.example: 【語意】The specification sets a tolerance rather than a single exact value. What is allowed?
A DEFINED RANGE OF ACCEPTABLE VARIATION.exampleZh: tolerance 在尺寸語境為明定容許偏差，不是任意值

THE APPARENT DISTANCES BETWEEN LAYERS.example: 【短文】A diagram exaggerates the gap between layers so readers can see their order. The caption says it is not to scale. What should not be copied directly?
THE APPARENT DISTANCES BETWEEN LAYERS.exampleZh: not to scale 不按比例，仍可準確展示順序

THE RELEVANCE OF THE RECOMMENDATION.meaning: 品質佳仍可能不適用特定問題
THE RELEVANCE OF THE RECOMMENDATION.example: 【語用】I am not questioning the quality; I am questioning whether it is the right answer to the problem we described. What is challenged?
THE RELEVANCE OF THE RECOMMENDATION.exampleZh: 品質佳仍可能不適用特定問題

ENTRY BY ANOTHER ROUTE.example: 【範圍】The absence of wet footprints rules out that particular route, given the story’s explicit rule that anyone using it would leave wet prints. What is not thereby ruled out?
ENTRY BY ANOTHER ROUTE.exampleZh: 題內給必留痕規則，否定該路不等於所有進路

THAT THE UNUSED BONUS WILL CARRY FORWARD.word: that the unused bonus will carry forward.
THAT THE UNUSED BONUS WILL CARRY FORWARD.meaning: 不能再以一般規則保留
THAT THE UNUSED BONUS WILL CARRY FORWARD.example: 【範圍】An unused bonus may be carried forward unless the player changes teams. A player changes teams. What can no longer be assumed?
THAT THE UNUSED BONUS WILL CARRY FORWARD.exampleZh: unless例外已觸發，不能再以一般規則保留

IT IS STILL AVAILABLE FOR CONSIDERATION.word: it is still available for consideration.
IT IS STILL AVAILABLE FOR CONSIDERATION.example: 【語意】The offer remains on the table, though neither party is committed to it. What is its status?
IT IS STILL AVAILABLE FOR CONSIDERATION.exampleZh: on the table仍可考慮；未承諾不等於已撤回

THEY AGREED WHILE RETAINING RESERVATIONS.example: 【語意】The group accepted the compromise reluctantly rather than enthusiastically. What is supported?
THEY AGREED WHILE RETAINING RESERVATIONS.exampleZh: reluctantly限制接受態度，不否定已接受

DOES NOT READILY ATTRACT ATTENTION.example: An inconspicuous outfit is one that does not readily attract attention.
DOES NOT READILY ATTRACT ATTENTION.exampleZh: inconspicuous描述不顯眼，不推定難穿或不實用

THE WALL DISPLAY.meaning: 更新頻率不決定實際先看哪個
THE WALL DISPLAY.example: 【指涉】The digital map is updated weekly; the wall display, less frequently. It is the latter that visitors tend to consult first. Which source is first consulted?
THE WALL DISPLAY.exampleZh: latter指第二者wall display，更新頻率不決定實際先看哪個

WHEN THAT DIRECT ROUTE IS AVAILABLE.word: when that direct route is available.
WHEN THAT DIRECT ROUTE IS AVAILABLE.example: 【推論】A route marked as direct crosses a courtyard that is open only during office hours. The reviewer recommends qualifying the label. What needs to be made explicit?
WHEN THAT DIRECT ROUTE IS AVAILABLE.exampleZh: direct並非一定不對，但依賴庭院開放時段，標籤需附可用條件

IF UNEXPECTED IRREGULARITIES OCCUR.meaning: 若出現非預期異常則自動覆蓋手動指令
IF UNEXPECTED IRREGULARITIES OCCUR.example: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
IF UNEXPECTED IRREGULARITIES OCCUR.exampleZh: Should... arise 省略 if 倒裝，表示若出現非預期異常則自動覆蓋手動指令

MAKES THE FEWEST EXPLANATORY ASSUMPTIONS.meaning: 應優先選擇假設前提最少者
MAKES THE FEWEST EXPLANATORY ASSUMPTIONS.example: 【篇章】Occam razor dictates that when presented with competing hypotheses, scientists should select the one that:
MAKES THE FEWEST EXPLANATORY ASSUMPTIONS.exampleZh: 奧坎剃刀（Occam razor）主張在相容的解釋假說中，應優先選擇假設前提最少者

HAD BEEN AVAILABLE.meaning: 過去才發現先前一直可取得
HAD BEEN AVAILABLE.example: We need not have carried the heavy guidebook; a copy had been available at the centre all along.
HAD BEEN AVAILABLE.exampleZh: 過去才發現先前一直可取得，用 had been available

THE NOTES.example: 【指涉】I can send the notes after the meeting, provided the chair agrees to their circulation. What does their refer to?
THE NOTES.exampleZh: circulation notes 指傳閱筆記，their 為notes所有格

THE APPARENT SOURCE OF MOTION.example: 【視角】At first the distant shapes seemed to drift. When I leaned against the wall, they settled: it was the boat beneath me that had been moving. What is revised?
THE APPARENT SOURCE OF MOTION.exampleZh: 原以遠物動，後知自身船動造成相對視覺

AN UNWORN ITEM RETURNED AFTER FIVE DAYS.word: an unworn item returned after five days.
AN UNWORN ITEM RETURNED AFTER FIVE DAYS.meaning: 非真實退換貨法律說明
AN UNWORN ITEM RETURNED AFTER FIVE DAYS.example: 【範圍】The shop’s fictional notice allows exchange for another size only if the item is unworn and returned within seven days. Which case meets both stated conditions?
AN UNWORN ITEM RETURNED AFTER FIVE DAYS.exampleZh: 題內兩必要條件and連用，非真實退換貨法律說明

VOLATILE FOOD AND ENERGY PRICE SWINGS.word: volatile food and energy price swings.
VOLATILE FOOD AND ENERGY PRICE SWINGS.meaning: 排除波動劇烈之糧食與能源價格
VOLATILE FOOD AND ENERGY PRICE SWINGS.example: 【微差】The report distinguishes between headline inflation, which includes volatile food and energy costs, and core inflation, which filters them out. What does core inflation exclude?
VOLATILE FOOD AND ENERGY PRICE SWINGS.exampleZh: core inflation 核心通膨：排除波動劇烈之糧食與能源價格

A REFLECTIVE SADNESS FOR WHAT HAS PASSED.word: a reflective sadness for what has passed.
A REFLECTIVE SADNESS FOR WHAT HAS PASSED.example: 【語意】The exhibition’s nostalgia is elegiac rather than celebratory. What tone predominates?
A REFLECTIVE SADNESS FOR WHAT HAS PASSED.exampleZh: elegiac 挽歌式哀思，不等於激烈要求復古

AN EMOTIONALLY RELEASING RESOLUTION.example: 【範圍】The ending withholds catharsis rather than merely postponing another revelation. What is withheld?
AN EMOTIONALLY RELEASING RESOLUTION.exampleZh: catharsis 為情緒宣洩淨化，與資訊揭露不同

WOULD HAVE PASSED.example: Had the ombudsman not intervened ex officio, the systemic cover-up would have passed unnoticed by parliamentary overseers.
WOULD HAVE PASSED.exampleZh: Had ... not intervened 為過去假設倒裝，主句配 would have passed unnoticed

IT CANNOT DEFINE THE ULTIMATE MORAL GOOD.word: it cannot define the ultimate moral good.
IT CANNOT DEFINE THE ULTIMATE MORAL GOOD.example: 【哲理】A legal philosopher argues that the rule of law is a negative virtue: it prevents arbitrary subjugation but cannot specify the ultimate good. What is its limit?
IT CANNOT DEFINE THE ULTIMATE MORAL GOOD.exampleZh: 法治為消極美德：防止專斷支配，但無法指明終極的善

IT RULES OUT NO LOGICAL POSSIBILITIES.word: it rules out no logical possibilities.
IT RULES OUT NO LOGICAL POSSIBILITIES.meaning: 因而未排除任何邏輯可能
IT RULES OUT NO LOGICAL POSSIBILITIES.example: 【邏輯】A tautology is a proposition that is true in every possible interpretation, yet it imparts zero empirical information. Why is it uninformative?
IT RULES OUT NO LOGICAL POSSIBILITIES.exampleZh: 重言式（tautology）在所有可能世界皆真，因而未排除任何邏輯可能，不帶經驗資訊

THE SECURITY DILEMMA.example: 【極致】The diplomat observes that strategic deterrence operates as a self-fulfilling prophecy: preparations undertaken for defense are interpreted by rivals as preparations for aggression. What dynamic is described?
THE SECURITY DILEMMA.exampleZh: security dilemma（安全困境）：自衛準備被敵手視為進攻威脅

WOULD HAVE METASTASIZED.example: Had the central bank not acted as lender of last resort, the liquidity crunch would have metastasized into systemic insolvency.
WOULD HAVE METASTASIZED.exampleZh: Had ... not acted ... would have metastasized 虛擬假設倒裝，表示惡化擴散

WITHIN TWO WEEKS FOLLOWING FORMAL FILING.word: within two weeks following formal filing.
WITHIN TWO WEEKS FOLLOWING FORMAL FILING.meaning: 在兩週內組成特別法庭
WITHIN TWO WEEKS FOLLOWING FORMAL FILING.example: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
WITHIN TWO WEEKS FOLLOWING FORMAL FILING.exampleZh: prescribe that + 原形虛擬式 be empaneled，在兩週內組成特別法庭

HAS DETERIORATED THROUGH AGE OR NEGLECT.word: has deteriorated through age or neglect
HAS DETERIORATED THROUGH AGE OR NEGLECT.example: A dilapidated building is one that has deteriorated through age or neglect.
HAS DETERIORATED THROUGH AGE OR NEGLECT.exampleZh: dilapidated 是年久或失修而破敗，不是簡約或特殊格局

CLOTHES OR MANNER OF DRESS.example: A sartorial choice is a choice concerning clothes or manner of dress.
CLOTHES OR MANNER OF DRESS.exampleZh: sartorial與服裝、穿著方式有關，不一定只限高級訂製
